population_selection: Unrelated western-European adults selected for GWAS, preferring the oldest family members. Exclusions: diabetes by self-report or FPG >=7.0 mmol/L; anemia at the reported sex-specific thresholds; missing HbA1c, erythrocytes or FPG. Source context: CTX_JANSEN_SELECTED.
measurement: BMI kg/m^2; age years; native FPG plasma mmol/L; HbA1c NGSP-percent affine representation of native IFCC; female=1,male=0 assumed encoding
moment_derivation: mathematical_properties.md: common Gaussian copula, actual marginal transforms, uniform covariance identity and independent source nuisance assumptions; calculated by analytic/calculate.py
